name: Track Batch
description: Rename, arm, mute, or set a send on the ticked tracks.

fields.label: Action: rename, arm, unarm, mute, unmute, send
fields.hint: Choose: rename, arm, unarm, mute, unmute, or send.

fields.label: Rename pattern ({name} {kind} {index})
fields.hint: Used when action is rename. Tokens: {name} = original name, {kind} = track type, {index} = track number.

fields.label: Send letter if action is send (A, B, C…)
fields.hint: Used when action is send. Enter the send return letter: A, B, C, etc.

fields.label: Send amount 0-1 (or 0-100)
fields.hint: Used when action is send. Amount from 0 (silent) to 1 (full). You can also use 0–100.
